cases.title: Campus heart and outdoor rooms
cases.finding: The SDF describes fragmented development and weak shared public space.
cases.response: Keep P3 as the academic commons, connect faculty courts and coordinate adjacent building frontages.
cases.nextStep: Confirm users, teaching schedules, event needs, accessible levels and the public-space brief.
cases.source: UNIVEN SDF 2022 pp.12,31; R8 public-space geometry

cases.title: Southern arrival / Gate 3
cases.finding: The original vision links a southern entrance to academic, administration and shared facilities.
cases.response: Add P9, a screened approach and a gate-position review marker. The location is inferred from the vision and local geometry.
cases.nextStep: Confirm official gate location, land/control, levels, vehicle turning, gate hours and safe pedestrian crossing.
cases.source: UNIVEN SDF 2022 p.68; R8-I southern arrival objects

cases.title: Walkway 6 · lighting and surface
cases.finding: The scored source record reports No lighting and Fair condition.
cases.response: Mark the affected record for field inspection; retain its relationship to the proposed campus network.
cases.nextStep: Inspect lighting, surface, drainage and sightlines; design repairs and measure the result. No safety improvement is yet demonstrated.

cases.title: Source 222 · identity and circulation
cases.finding: The source footprint sits within an enclosed courtyard-like opening; no screened external link was found.
cases.response: Keep this as a source-identity and internal-circulation investigation, not proof of a real access deficiency.
cases.nextStep: Confirm what source ID222 represents, its actual internal entrance/circulation and levels before proposing external access works.
cases.source: Source context ID222; R8 access validation

cases.title: Walking surfaces and utility envelopes
cases.finding: 3,871.34 m² of the current walking-surface union intersects supplied utility envelopes.
cases.response: Keep the mapped walking-surface overlap and the separate new-study overlap as summary quantities. Detailed utility geometry is excluded from this public edition; the populations can overlap and must not be added.
cases.nextStep: Ask utility owners to verify positions, depths, capacity and working requirements before any excavation or foundations.
cases.source: Seven supplied envelope layers; R8 union-intersection calculation

cases.title: Road interfaces and pedestrian priority
cases.finding: 2,090.22 m² of current walking surfaces intersects recorded road geometry.
cases.response: Retain the vehicle framework and highlight the interfaces needing crossing design.
cases.nextStep: Assess real movements, speeds, levels, visibility, traffic operations and emergency access; design each interface.
cases.source: Corrected New_UD302 slab geometry; R8 walking surfaces

cases.title: Boundary and survey alignment
cases.finding: 45 supplied boundary segments have 12 open ends; accepted campus area and containment are unavailable.
cases.response: Display the actual incomplete linework in plan and model; do not close gaps to invent a parcel.
cases.nextStep: Obtain accepted survey control and a closed cadastral boundary; reconcile Lo29/Lo31 naming.
cases.source: UD201 PROPERTY BOUNDARY; source alignment record

cases.title: Outstanding accommodation requirement
cases.finding: 28 requirements remain unsited and four partly placed; 129,150.91 m² remains unresolved.
cases.response: Keep all 82 requirements visible, with placed allocation, unresolved balance and source identity.
cases.nextStep: Confirm current demand and room/bed/laboratory briefs, then test additional capacity or programme changes.

cases.title: Covered frontages and landscape
cases.finding: The SDF identifies poor shade and walking comfort; tree symbols alone do not prove performance.
cases.response: Add covered-frontage study strips beside selected learning/shared buildings and retain planted courts.
cases.nextStep: Test solar exposure, structure, drainage, roots, maintenance and continuous accessible movement.
cases.source: UNIVEN SDF 2022 pp.12,68; R8 covered-frontage geometry

cases.title: Public access and residential privacy
cases.finding: The SDF distinguishes public arrivals, shared student spaces and more private academic/residential functions.
cases.response: Restore public-private precinct intent and residential-sport thresholds as concept overlays.
cases.nextStep: Agree actual access rights, hours, safeguarding, residential privacy and service routes.
